title: Elite-Driven Support Vector Machines for Classification
summary: Support vector machines (SVMs) are a standard tool for binary classification, but their classical formulations are purely data-driven and offer no direct way to encode trusted benchmark models or structured preferences on selected subsets of the data. We propose Elite-Driven Support Vector Machines (EDSVM), a general framework that augments regularized empirical risk minimization by guiding the slack variables for a curated set of elite observations (typically the union of support vectors from one or more reference SVMs).
